plugins.name: vstack
plugins.description: Cavalry Visual Stack — visual-first delivery for Claude Code: plan, design, and build software on artifacts you operate, not documents you read. init — start a project from the Cavalry template, choosing stack and add-ons on a visual chooser. wireframe — build a UI wireframe and comment directly on it in a review workspace. user-story-map — plan releases on an interactive drag-and-drop story map. phase-wireframe — see a signed-off mockup at each release phase.
